newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil gov't coffee auction only likely next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil gov't coffee auction only likely next week.

text.p: The next Brazilian auction of government coffee stocks is now likely to be held on July 15 or July 16, said the secretary-general of the Brazilian Coffee Industry Association (Abic) which represents roasters.

The monthly sale was originally scheduled to be held on July 2 but was postponed pending the official publication of an extension in the payment terms to 120 days from a previous 60 days, said David Nahum.
The notification was published in the government's official gazette on July 4 and the advisory for the auction should now be issued in the coming days, he added.
However given five working days' notice is needed for the sale, it was likely that the auction would only be held on July 15 or 16, Nahum said.
A sale on July 15 would coincide with a meeting of members of Brazil's new coffee council, known as the CDPC, in Brasilia.
The members will hold talks ahead of the next official council session which is scheduled to be held in Santos although no final date has been set.
